source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: When no truthy password is supplied, the Account Hub filler selects the retained incoming password, then the outgoing password, and passes that value to replaceVariables. hasPassword reports presence as a Boolean. replaceVariables only writes truthy supplied credentials and applies the selected value to incoming, outgoing and alternatives. The old empty argument did not clear all retained passwords. This fallback can replace a different outgoing credential, so it is not a general claim that both original credentials remain unchanged. No setup test was executed.
title: Account Hub fills missing password input from retained credentials
